correctness.rationale: Acyclic indegree,outdegree <=1 forces each weak component to be a uniformly directed finite, omega, omega*, or Z path. In any exact successor linear order, components are convex blocks; with finitely many components no dense accumulation can avoid adjacency. Adjacent component blocks are forbidden exactly if left has greatest and right has least. Each gap between successive finite blocks requires its own Z component, giving f-1<=z. Conversely concatenate all omega blocks, f finite blocks separated by Z, extra Z, and omega* blocks to realize f<=z+1. Adding t disjoint Z components gives sharp t=max(0,f-z-1). Independently checked all 5460 four-type strings of lengths <=6 against explicit order permutation enumeration, no disagreement.
